scope: Runner metadata, not a test result or publication approval

nativeHarness.freshVm: Use a fresh native Play VM or uncached correctly reparented source clones. Edit require cache is not current-source evidence.
nativeHarness.isolation: Disable ServerScriptService.Server and StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Client entry scripts before isolated fixtures. Use disposable QA modules/ScreenGui. Restore original Disabled values and text preference on every exit.
nativeHarness.client: client = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Client; parent = an enabled disposable ScreenGui descendant under LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
nativeHarness.sources: Read current hostSource=src/server/init.server.lua, profileSource=src/server/PlayerProgress.lua, sessionSource=src/server/SessionProfile.lua and inject exact text arguments.
nativeHarness.results: pcall each returned spec function. Result.passed or native array length is case count. Preserve initial failures and separately identify superseding reruns.
nativeHarness.sourceGate: Compare all native Source strings with source-manifest.json after identical BOM/newline normalization. Re-run manifest after the final UI edits; an earlier hash snapshot does not certify a later source revision.

serverSpecs.coverage: 1296 count combinations per channel across all seven identities

serverSpecs.gates: max follow speed <=18.001, max chase gap <16, final gap <0.1; continuity, bounded pivots and true travel tangent

layoutMatrix.note: Record actual native preference and root dimensions. Fixtures do not establish physical-phone comfort or performance.

visualDriver.note: Use real RenderStepped pinned-camera captures. There is no matched v250 baseline mode. Call destroy to restore lighting, camera and UI.

evidenceLimits: Isolated stores are not service-backed outage/rejoin proof.
Protocol tests are not actual two-client privacy observations.
Solver wins are not human balance evidence.
Do not sum reruns or fixture variants as independent new cases.
